title: S01-03 - The Strixwolf Mother
hook: A creature steps from behind the cart: wolf-bodied, owl-faced, wings folded tight. Two pups stumble behind her. Her eyes judge whether you are danger or mercy.

blocks.label: Where You Are
blocks.body: A creature steps from behind the cart: wolf-bodied, owl-faced, wings folded tight. Two pups stumble behind her. Her eyes judge whether you are danger or mercy.

blocks.label: Plain Stakes
blocks.body: A strange winged wolf-owl mother guards her pups while feeding from the dead driver.

blocks.label: Visible Options
blocks.body: Soothe her Attack her Back away Inspect from afar

affordances: Who notices the Strixwolf pups first, and why does that matter to you?
What do you do with your hands so the mother knows you are not hunting?
What sound tells you this is a parent, not a monster?
